segments.sn22.27:1.4: Yāvatā rūpassa assādo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
segments.sn22.27:1.7: Yāvatā rūpassa ādīnavo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
segments.sn22.27:1.10: Yāvatā rūpassa nissaraṇaṃ paññāya me taṃ sudiṭṭhaṃ.
segments.sn22.27:1.11: Vedanāyāhaṃ, bhikkhave … saññāyāhaṃ, bhikkhave … saṅkhārānāhaṃ, bhikkhave … viññāṇassāhaṃ, bhikkhave, assādapariyesanaṃ acariṃ.
segments.sn22.27:1.16: Yāvatā viññāṇassa assādo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
segments.sn22.27:1.19: Yāvatā viññāṇassa ādīnavo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
segments.sn22.27:1.22: Yāvatā viññāṇassa nissaraṇaṃ paññāya me taṃ sudiṭṭhaṃ.
segments.sn22.27:1.23: Yāvakīvañcāhaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsiṃ … pe … abbhaññāsiṃ.
segments.sn22.27:1.26: ‘akuppā me vimutti [cetovimutti (sī. pī. ka.)]; ayamantimā jāti; natthi dāni punabbhavo’”ti.

lines: Paṭipāṭiyā panettha pañcamachaṭṭhasattamesu cattāri saccāni kathitāni, aṭṭhamanavamesu vaṭṭavivaṭṭaṃ.
25-30. Dhātusaṃyutte vuttanayeneva veditabbāni, kevalañhi ettha khandhavasena desanā āgatā, tattha dhātuvasenāti ayameva viseso.
